title.value: Clipped Stochastic Methods for Variational Inequalities with Heavy-Tailed Noise
title.justification: The title of the paper is clearly mentioned at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: Clipped Stochastic Methods for Variational Inequalities with Heavy-Tailed Noise

analysis.description: This paper investigates clipped stochastic methods to solve variational inequality problems (VIPs) with non-sub-Gaussian (heavy-tailed) noise and unbounded domains. It derives high-probability results with logarithmic dependence on the confidence level for these stochastic methods. It also empirically validates that in several GAN formulations, gradient noise is heavy-tailed and demonstrates that gradient clipping improves the performance of SEG/SGDA.
